title: isoparse('9999-12-31T24:00') raises OverflowError instead of ValueError
property: isoparse signals every string it cannot turn into a datetime with ValueError
expected: ValueError, like every other out-of-range input (year 0000, month 13, hour 25)
actual: OverflowError: date value out of range, raised from `datetime(*components) + timedelta(days=1)`
evidence: The parser consistently reports bad or unrepresentable input as ValueError (the docstring's own examples of failing strings, and every internal check). Callers doing `except ValueError` are bypassed only by the 24:00 path, which adds a timedelta after construction.
